description: We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who love space exploration, game design, and coding. Our project is an interactive space mission design game where players plan real-world-inspired missions: choosing destinations, spacecraft, budgets, fuel, and crew while managing risks. It turns NASA science into hands-on learning. We bring skills in programming, creative design, and storytelling. We're looking for teammates with experience in game development (Unity/Godot/JavaScript), 3D art or UI/UX
summary:
MissionX: 3D Space Mission Simulator
MissionX is a high-performance 3D spaceflight game running entirely inside a single HTML file.  
Engineer Mode: Design a custom spacecraft by balancing mass, budget, and power. Launch your rocket, steer through asteroid fields, and secure a lunar orbit.  
Story Mode: Manually pilot a lunar lander to the surface. Disembark for a 3D EVA moonwalk to repair your ship, defeat an alien boss for fuel, and parachute back to an Earth splashdown.  
The Tech: Built with vanilla JavaScript, procedural Three.js graphics, and real-time synthesized Web Audio. No heavy game engines, image files, or external audio assets—just pure, hyper-optimized code.
details:
Source Code: https://github.com/Kishorekumar-23/missionx

What it does & How it works:

MissionX is a lightweight, high-performance 3D space mission simulator running entirely in the browser. It features a dual-path educational gameplay loop. In "Engineer Mode," players learn orbital mechanics by building a spacecraft—balancing mass, power draw, and budget constraints before launching on various rocket tiers. In "Story Mode," players recreate a lunar landing, featuring a manual 3D descent module, a fully playable EVA Moonwalk, and a gamified fuel-recovery sequence.

Tools, Coding Languages, & Software:

The project was built using Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and modern CSS3 (utilizing a Glassmorphism UI). We used Three.js for 3D WebGL rendering and the native Web Audio API for custom sound synthesis.
